svg.title: On every finite torus H, B are symmetric positive matrices. The supplied pledge, amend, bail and treble rows represent A, G, R, D, respectively. Positivity gives A > 0 and R ≥I, so their analytic inverses G and D exist with uniform narrower strip bounds. Exterior nilpotency gives XHd1 = 0, hence AHd1 = d1, Gd1 = Hd1 and d∗ 1Gd1 = d∗ 1Hd1.
